# Content Publishing Checklist

## Article information

- **Title:**
- **Article slug:**
- **Topic:** Java / Quarkus / Spring Boot / Open Source / AI
- **Languages:** English and Portuguese
- **Canonical blog URL:**
- **Related GitHub PR or repository:**

## 1. Blog — Quarkus Roq

**Format:** Full technical article

**Goal:** Build my technical portfolio and knowledge base.

- [ ] Title and description are clear.
- [ ] Article is written in Markdown.
- [ ] Portuguese and English versions are present, with reciprocal language links.
- [ ] Code examples are correct and reproducible.
- [ ] Technical claims are supported by code or references.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive information are exposed.
- [ ] Images have descriptive alternative text.
- [ ] Internal and external links are valid.
- [ ] Article renders correctly in Roq.
- [ ] Static site build passes.

## 2. DEV.to

**Format:** Full or adapted technical article

**Goal:** Reach the developer community.

- [ ] DEV.to version has been generated.
- [ ] Introduction is adapted for DEV.to readers.
- [ ] Code formatting has been reviewed.
- [ ] Canonical URL points to the original blog article.
- [ ] Up to four relevant tags are selected.
- [ ] Technical details match the original article.
- [ ] DEV.to draft is ready for publication.

## 3. LinkedIn

**Format:** Short post — Problem → Solution → Result

**Goal:** Attract recruiters and start technical conversations.

- [ ] Opening hook is clear.
- [ ] Problem is explained concisely.
- [ ] Technical approach is understandable.
- [ ] Result is accurate and verifiable.
- [ ] Link to the original article is included.
- [ ] Relevant hashtags are included.
- [ ] Language and tone are professional.
- [ ] LinkedIn post is ready for publication.

## 4. Final review

- [ ] English and Portuguese grammar reviewed.
- [ ] No invented metrics, benchmarks or results.
- [ ] No unsupported claims about the implementation.
- [ ] All three content versions are consistent.
- [ ] Build and automated checks pass.
- [ ] Ready to merge into main.

## Post-publication

- [ ] Blog URL verified.
- [ ] DEV.to article published.
- [ ] LinkedIn post published.
- [ ] Published links recorded.
